idea-plugin.name: Perplexity AI Chat
idea-plugin.description:
Integrate Perplexity AI directly into your IDE

This plugin embeds Perplexity AI into IntelliJ-based IDEs, allowing you to:

  • Browse Perplexity AI without leaving your IDE
  • Send selected code to Perplexity chat with Ctrl+Shift+P
  • Automatic dark mode support
  • Session token management for persistent login
  • Adjustable zoom controls
  • Developer tools access for debugging

Features:

  • Native tool window integration
  • Context menu action for sending code
  • Persistent settings (zoom level, session token)
  • Off-screen rendering for Windows compatibility
